welcomeMsg:
How can I help you today?

I am trained on the 2026/27 and 2026 DataMB Pro dataset (55 leagues). I can answer any question about the data and handle complex requests — from metric definitions to advanced analysis, scouting reports, and deeper insights.

Enable the graph toggle for on-demand charts and visual queries.
disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Check other tools for reference.
